semanticReview.method: Manual comparison with Taiwan MOE Hanyu Pinyin initial and syllable tables

findings.supports: Printed p. 6 lists ㄅ/ㄆ/ㄇ/ㄈ in the initial consonant table. Printed pp. 13, 15, 16 and 18 show the syllables ㄅㄚ/bā, ㄆㄚ/pā, ㄇㄚ/mā and ㄈㄚ/fā with characters.

limitations: Removed Spanish sound approximations and unreferenced articulatory explanations; retained only the source table’s transcription correspondences.
